issue.title: [Mellanox] syncd container has Python development packages installed

failure.body:
#### Description

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:

In the syncd container for Mellanox images, on master and 202405 branches, there are Python development packages and setuptools installed. These should be removed.

#### Describe the results you received:

```
root@str-msn2700-01:/# dpkg -l | grep python | grep dev
ii  libpython3-dev:amd64               3.11.2-1+b1                    amd64        header files and a static library for Python (default)
ii  libpython3.11-dev:amd64            3.11.2-6+deb12u2               amd64        Header files and a static library for Python (v3.11)
ii  python-sdk-api                     1.mlnx.4.6.4072                amd64        SX SDK API python wrapper module for SX devices.
ii  python3-dev                        3.11.2-1+b1                    amd64        header files and a static library for Python (default)
ii  python3.11-dev                     3.11.2-6+deb12u2               amd64        Header files and a static library for Python (v3.11)
root@str-msn2700-01:/# dpkg -l | grep python | grep setuptools
ii  python3-setuptools                 66.1.1-1                       all          Python3 Distutils Enhancements
```

#### Describe the results you expected:

Development packages shouldn't be installed at runtime.
